subject: Catalyst Health — compliance recap & next steps
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@catalysthealth.com>, security@catalysthealth.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Catalyst Health — compliance recap & next steps

Hi Liam / Catalyst security team,

Thanks again for taking time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Highlights from the demo
- Redwood supports text generation, embeddings, and private deployment modes you asked about.
- We run on a production-first runtime; we also maintain a SOC 2 Type II report (most recent audit: June 2027).

Compliance items you flagged
- SOC 2 Type II report access and a short bridge letter/attestation for procurement.
- HIPAA applicability for patient data and encryption at rest/in transit details.
- GDPR/DP processing questions for EU residents (if that applies later).
- Completion of your vendor security questionnaire (DDQ) and a brief technical call.

Proposed next steps (timeline intent)
1) Share our SOC 2 summary + bridge letter draft (attached) — I'll upload the full Type II report to our trust portal if you confirm an email for read-only access (target: 48 hours).
2) Please send your DDQ (attached is the filename you can expect back from us once completed) or point us to the questionnaire URL; we can start answering within 2 business days.
3) Legal / BAA: we can start a BAA discussion right away; I can loop in legal or share our standard BAA doc.
4) Security deep-dive: propose a 30-min call with Monica (our security lead) next week to go over encryption, key management, and deployment isolation.

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary_202706.pdf, bridge_letter_template.docx

Please let me know the best contact to grant trust portal access (email) and whether HIPAA requires any bespoke contractual language on your side. Happy to prioritize.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0182

---
Redwood Inference — production-first inference platform.

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@catalysthealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@catalysthealth.com
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 09:42:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Catalyst Health — compliance recap & next steps

Thanks Aditya — this is helpful. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Catalyst Health is a covered entity; HIPAA applies to any PHI we process. We will need a signed BAA before production. Is Redwood willing to execute a BAA?
- Encryption: can you confirm encryption at rest is enabled by default for dedicated and private deployments, and whether keys can be customer-managed (KMS/HSM)?
- SOC 2: we saw the summary but procurement usually requires the full Type II report and a bridge letter attesting no material changes since the report date. Can you provide both (or temporary attestation) while the portal invite is provisioned?

I attached our vendor DDQ (catalyst_ddq_v2.xlsx) — please confirm scope and an estimated turnaround on answers. Also — please invite security@catalysthealth.com to your trust portal with read-only permissions for the report.

Appreciate the quick turnaround. If you can get the portal invite and a bridge attestation within 48 hours, that will keep procurement moving.

—
Liam O'Connor
Director, IT Security
Catalyst Health
liam.oconnor@catalysthealth.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@catalysthealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, security@catalysthealth.com
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Catalyst Health — compliance recap & next steps

Liam — thanks, and totally understood on HIPAA/BAA. Next actions from our side (I will own / coordinate):

1) BAA: Redwood is willing to execute a BAA. I'll kick off our legal intake and share a DocuSign link — estimated turnaround for initial signature: 3 business days (we can accelerate if procurement needs it sooner). Link: https://redwood.ai/legal/baa-docs

2) Trust portal access: I will provision a read-only account for security@catalysthealth.com and upload the full SOC 2 Type II report (redwood_soc2_typeii_report_202706.pdf) plus a signed bridge letter (bridge_letter_signed.pdf). Expect the portal invite within 24–48 hours. (Screenshot of the invite flow attached: trust_portal_invite_screenshot.png)

3) Encryption / KMS: short answer — yes. Encryption at rest and in transit is enabled by default across our deployments. For Dedicated and Private we support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and HSM options). Monica will join the technical call to go over key rotation and separation of duties.

4) DDQ: we reviewed the attached catalyst_ddq_v2.xlsx and opened a tracker. To make progress quickly I've created a secure questionnaire workspace and a shareable link where you can track answers and comment: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/placeholder-ddq-id (we can also push the completed PDF back to you). We estimate 4–5 business days to provide full responses for a standard DDQ; critical items first if you flag them. Attached: ddq_link.txt

5) Technical call: propose Tue 21 Sep, 11:00–11:30 PT for Monica (security) + Ben (solutions) — please confirm your availability and any additional attendees.

If that plan works I'll: (a) send the DocuSign BAA link, (b) provision the trust portal invite (security@catalysthealth.com), and (c) create the DDQ workspace and start populating answers.

Thanks — happy to escalate anything to our compliance team if procurement requests more detail.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai
